items.text: (a) Using Table 1, calculate the rate of growth of real GDP in Marenia between Year 2 and Year 3. [2 marks]
(b) Using Table 1, calculate the unemployment rate in Year 3 and, using information from Extract B, explain one reason why it has changed since Year 1. [4 marks]
(c) Using an AD/AS diagram, explain the likely effect of the central bank's decision on real GDP and the price level in Marenia. [4 marks]
(d) Using information from Extract B and your knowledge of economics, discuss whether the central bank was right to raise its policy rate. [8 marks]
Can you check my working for (a), (b) and (c), tell me exactly where I went wrong with the correct numbers shown step by step, and give me a provisional mark for each of those three parts?
For (d) please don't write it for me, just tell me which evaluation points from the extract and the table I should use and what my judgement should depend on.
